lead.event: Indonesia enacts the Indonesia International Financial Center law
lead.headline: Indonesia enacts financial center law with 100% corporate tax reduction
lead.blurb: Signed by President Prabowo Subianto on 19 August, Law No. 6 of 2026 creates special zones for financial businesses including banking, capital markets, insurance and family offices. It also sets 0% final income tax for financial-sector professionals and ad hoc judges, with VAT non-collection and import-duty exemptions. The framework includes a special court that may include foreign ad hoc judges. Implementing regulations are due within six months of promulgation.

market_structure_policy.event: OJK discloses sanctions in capital-market manipulation cases
market_structure_policy.headline: OJK says violators paid Rp2.1 trillion in capital-market sanctions
market_structure_policy.blurb: The fines cover coordinated trading in DSSA shares and allocation violations in the BREN and CUAN offerings. OJK has examined 31 of the 61 stocks on the IDX High Shareholding Concentration list for potential criminal violations.
market_structure_policy.copy_decision: rewritten: 3 new articles with a new fact: OJK had examined 31 of the 61 stocks on the IDX High Shareholding Concentration list for potential criminal violations.

capital_raising_buybacks.headline: MBMA plans second private placement targeting Rp3.2 trillion
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Merdeka Battery Materials proposes up to 10.8 billion new shares, equal to 10% of its capital, with dilution of up to 9.09%. About 25% of the proceeds is planned for working capital, with the rest for business development. Shareholders will be asked to approve the proposal on 8 December 2026.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Tower Bersama announces a share buyback of up to Rp106 billion
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: TBIG announces share buyback of up to Rp106 billion
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: The plan covers up to 52.8 million shares, or 0.23% of fully paid-up capital. Tower Bersama plans to run the three-month buyback from 2 November to 29 January 2027. Management says it will not significantly affect earnings per share or materially harm operations.

earnings_guidance.headline: SRTG reports Rp3.47 trillion Q3 2026 profit
earnings_guidance.blurb: Saratoga Investama reversed a Rp2.43 trillion loss in the same period last year. Stock and securities gains contributed Rp2.34 trillion, dividends Rp1.74 trillion and emerging-company gains Rp639.12 billion.

earnings_guidance.headline: BNBR reports nine-month revenue of Rp4.12 trillion, up 55%
earnings_guidance.blurb: Bakrie & Brothers’ operating profit increased 2,157.14% to Rp596.24 billion, while EBITDA rose 707.86% to Rp810.25 billion. The company posted a net loss attributable to the parent of Rp341.85 billion, versus net profit of Rp11.65 billion a year earlier; director Roy Hendrajanto M. Sakti attributed the decline mainly to higher floating-rate interest expenses on CCT in the early years after its acquisition.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: Operating profit increased 2,157.14% to Rp596.24 billion.

earnings_guidance.event: Barito Pacific reports nine-month 2026 financial results
earnings_guidance.headline: BRPT reports nine-month results as revenue rises 56.3% to USD8.69 billion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Petrochemicals contributed USD8.19 billion, energy USD501 million and other segments USD4 million. Net profit after tax was USD616 million, and the net debt-to-equity ratio was 0.77x.

earnings_guidance.event: BREN reports nine-month profit growth despite a year-to-date share decline
earnings_guidance.headline: BREN reports 21.8% nine-month profit growth despite 81.49% YTD share fall
earnings_guidance.blurb: Barito Renewables' revenue rose 9.5% to USD501 million and EBITDA increased 10.9% to USD442 million, with its EBITDA margin widening to 88.2% from 87.1%. Higher operating profit and lower financial expenses drove the net profit increase.

other.event: BIKE subsidiary secures a PLN Indonesia Power EPC contract
other.headline: BIKE subsidiary wins Rp3.8 trillion EPC contract from PLN Indonesia Power
other.blurb: Karya Bersinar Indonesia, a BIKE subsidiary, will handle EPC work for a 2 x 100 MW gas engine power plant. BIKE expects the project to add a source of business revenue.

other.event: Attorney General raids IPPS in Toba Pulp Lestari corruption probe
other.headline: Prosecutors raid IPPS in INRU probe over suspected 2008-2025 transfer-pricing corruption
other.blurb: The Attorney General’s Office seized documents and electronic evidence at IPPS’s Jakarta office. Prosecutors suspect Toba Pulp Lestari director and former corporate secretary AL manipulated export invoices, and have designated the company a corporate suspect.

macro_flows.event: MSCI reclassification proposal draws foreign selling and OJK response
macro_flows.headline: MSCI reclassification proposal draws Rp17.87 trillion in foreign net selling
macro_flows.blurb: Over 11 trading days from 16 to 30 October, investors sold net on the regular market after MSCI proposed moving Indonesia from emerging-market to standalone status. OJK Chairwoman Friderica Widyasari Dewi said Indonesia remained unsuitable for standalone status, despite meeting 16 of 18 market-accessibility indicators in June 2026; MSCI’s consultation runs until April 2027, with a final decision due by 30 June 2027.
